indicators.text: OFAC SDN delta batch designates >=3 shadow-fleet crude/product tankers (with IMO/MMSI) or a third-country dual-use procurement network.
BIS or USTR places a rule stay, suspension extension, or Entity List expansion on Federal Register public inspection within 14 days of a scheduled deadline.
IGC Grains and Oilseeds Index and MPOB palm-oil quotes move >=2% in the same direction ahead of the monthly FAO FFPI release.

warning_problems.title: Sanctions enforcement surge or export-control cliff
warning_problems.watch_condition: Continuous monitoring of OFAC SDN delta publications and BIS/USTR Federal Register public-inspection filings.
warning_problems.issue_on_change: Issue a warning item when OFAC designates a maritime tanker fleet or dual-use procurement ring, or when an export-control stay approaches within 14 days without a filed extension.
warning_problems.deactivation: Rule stay or final rule is published in the Federal Register and affected shipping/trade corridors adjust.

hypotheses.title: Coordinated enforcement tightening against shadow-fleet energy revenue or dual-use transshipment
Calibrated diplomatic truce extension via synchronized BIS/USTR administrative stays
Administrative publication lag or technical identifier correction (artefact)
